title: The BEST nature in GUADALAJARA, MEXICO
description:
We're an American couple traveling in Mexico. In this travel vlog, we're visiting a beautiful forest in the colonial city Guadalajara, Jalisco.
► Want to learn Spanish? Try what we use: https://www.rocketlanguages.com/spanish/premium?type=sales&aff=tangerinet

While traveling through Mexico, we're always looking for fun, inexpensive things to do. Now we're in a new city and looking for free things to do in Guadalajara, Mexico. A few people commented on our last video recommending Bosque Los Colomos, so we went there for some cheap fun in Guadalajara Mexico! 

If you're also looking for Guadalajara, Mexico tourism and to be living cheap in Guadalajara, we totally recommend visiting a park in Mexico! Specifically, Parque Los Colomos It's absolutely stunning with the Japanese garden Mexico version, lots of animals, and workout equipment. We didn't realize Guadalajara parks were so diverse! The nature in Guadalajara, Mexico is unique and memorable.

ABOUT US (MADDIE & JORDAN)
In January 2018, we sold everything we owned in the US (except our husky Laska & what fit in our tiny, tangerine Prius C3) to travel the world—starting with Mexico. Since then, we've been making travel videos about our life in Mexico and the new experiences we encounter while traveling the world. If you'd like to join our shenanigans, subscribe to our YouTube channel. You can also poke around our social media to find out what we’re up to each week.
